LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_SpiritBeads.label: [Raven] Spirit Egg Beads
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_SpiritBeads.description:
A special "weapon" strung together from five unfertilized spirit eggs. It is not only a chic accessory for the Raven race but also a deadly blunt weapon under specific techniques.

Special Mechanics:
Can be sheathed on the body. When instantly drawn and swung, it deals extremely high damage and plunges the enemy into intense dizziness (Stun and Weakness).

Ultimate Skill (Requires manual activation):
[Grand Liberation] — Instantly subdues all enemies on the map.
